verses.text: Mamin Jehová, manh in a tumej yet' yowal a k'ool. Manh ak' in yaelal ayik skot owal t'ayin.
Mamin, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, yujto manhxalaj wip swab'i. Mamin, ak'xi b'ox in k'ool yujto a in niwanil tik sluklon yuj manh ipal.
Te somchajnak in k'ool. Ha achxo Mamin Jehová, ¿b'aq'uinh ol ach och wet'ok?
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kolinel yet' wal a niwan wach'k'olal.
¿Tom ay mach olto ach naankotok ayik toxo ix chami? Malaj junok mach ol b'itan t'ayach t'a skal heb' yetchamnakil chi'.
Ste el wip woq'ui. Manh jantakok wok' t'a junjun ak'wal. Sch'ayxiel in k'anh jolom yuj yal in sat.
Maxtzak yal-laj wilani, yujto ix mal in sat woq'ui yujnhej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Elanhek t'a in tz'ey a ex to anhej chukal tze k'ulej. Toxo ix yab' Jehová in sik'sik'an woq'ui.
Toxo ix yab' in tewi t'ay. Toxo ix scha in lesal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelal. Tonhej ol somchajkanel heb'. T'a junnhej mutz'satil ol kan heb' t'a q'uixwelk'olal.
